data.cultural_impact: The name Lib, being derived from the ancient Greek word 'libos', was adopted as a given name by early Christians. Its light and free meaning reflected the concept of liberation and freedom from sin. This continued into modern times, with Lib being a popular name for both boys and girls, particularly in Latin America and Europe.

It symbolizes the importance of living a virtuous and upright life through the guidance of the Holy Spirit. The name Libbianca, meaning "white as a lib" in Latin, further emphasizes the spiritual meaning of the name, signifying purity and holiness.
